name: textvis
description: TextVis: turns a research paper PDF into a knowledge graph, a narrated 3D lecture video and an interactive Godot scene.

scripts.check: for f in agents/*.mjs llm/*.mjs visual/*.mjs tools/*.mjs pipeline/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.metrics: node tools/metric-noun-repetition.mjs --all --json results/noun_repetition.json && node tools/metric-label-proximity.mjs --all --json results/label_proximity.json
